remarks: Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this 1-bedroom rental in Glenbrook with heat & hot water included! Step inside and you will find a bright open concept living room/Kitchen, spacious bedroom with a double closet and a large full bath. Hardwood floors throughout. Storage won't be an issue with the abundance of closet space available in the unit plus the additional private large storage cage. Laundry on-site in basement. Outside, you'll find one reserved parking space, ensuring hassle-free parking. Plus, with easy access to the Glenbrook Train Station just a 6-minute walk away, commuting is a breeze. Additionally walking distance to nearby restaurants, shops, and entertainment plus conveniently situated near I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. Don't miss out on this opportunity! Schedule your viewing today!
